   491	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   492	                            tracing::warn!(
   493	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   494	                                reason = %reason,
   495	                                "bead closed but shipped-work check failed — reopening and releasing"
   496	                            );
   497	                            let report = GateReport::single_failure("shipped_work", reason);
   498	                            return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;
   499	                        }
   500	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {}
   501	                        Err(e) => {
   502	                            tracing::warn!(
   503	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   504	                                error = %e,
   505	                                "shipped-work check errored — failing open"
   506	                            );
   507	                        }
   508	                    }
   509	                }
   510	
   511	                // Dispatch is fully accounted for — drop its snapshot so the
   512	                // next claim of this bead starts from a fresh baseline.
   513	                crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   514	
   515	                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "bead confirmed closed by agent");
   516	                events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   517	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   518	                    duration_ms: 0,
   519	                });
   520	                // Increment success_count for any skills that matched this bead.
   521	                if !bead.workspace.as_os_str().is_empty() {
   522	                    if let Ok(lib) = crate::skill::SkillLibrary::load(&bead.workspace) {
   523	                        if let Err(e) = lib.increment_success_for_bead(&bead.labels, &bead.title) {
   524	                            tracing::warn!(
   525	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   526	                                error = %e,
   527	                                "failed to increment skill success counts"
   528	                            );
   529	                        }
   530	                    }
   531	                }
   532	            }
   533	            Ok(Some(current)) => {
   534	                tracing::warn!(
   535	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   536	                    status = %current.status,
   537	                    "agent exited successfully but bead is still open (orphaned)"
   538	                );
   539	                events.push(EventKind::BeadOrphaned {
   540	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   541	                });
   542	
   543	                // Use verify_shipped_work to decide close-vs-release.
   544	                // If the agent shipped work, mark as completed. Otherwise, release
   545	                // and increment failure count so repeat offenders quarantine.
   546	                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {
   547	                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {
   548	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {
   549	                            tracing::info!(
   550	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   551	                                "shipped work detected — marking orphaned bead as completed"
   552	                            );
   553	                            // Clear the predispatch snapshot since work is complete.
   554	                            crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   555	                            // Mark as completed - the agent shipped work but forgot to close.
   556	                            // We can't close via bead store (no close method), so emit completion
   557	                            // event and release. The bead remains open but work is done.
   558	                            events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   559	                                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   560	                                duration_ms: 0,
   561	                            });
   562	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   563	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   564	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   565	                        }
   566	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   567	                            tracing::warn!(
   568	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   569	                                reason = %reason,
   570	                                "no shipped work detected — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   571	                            );
   572	                            // Release and increment failure count to apply quarantine.
   573	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   574	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   575	                            let release_succeeded = events
   576	                                .iter()
   577	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   578	                            if release_succeeded {
   579	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   580	                            }
   581	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   582	                        }
   583	                        Err(e) => {
   584	                            tracing::warn!(
   585	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   586	                                error = %e,
   587	                                "shipped-work check errored — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   588	                            );
   589	                            // On error, release and increment failure count.
   590	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   591	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   592	                            let release_succeeded = events
   593	                                .iter()
   594	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   595	                            if release_succeeded {
   596	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   597	                            }
   598	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   599	                        }
   600	                    }
   601	                } else {
   602	                    tracing::warn!(
   603	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   604	                        "enforce_shipped_work disabled — releasing orphaned bead"
   605	                    );
   606	                    // If enforce_shipped_work is disabled, just release without closing.
   607	                    let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   608	                    events.append(&mut release_events);
   609	                    return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   610	                }
   611	            }
   612	            Ok(None) => {
   613	                // Timeout - we cannot verify bead closure, so release to enforce postcondition.
   614	                tracing::warn!(
   615	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   616	                    "show() timed out, releasing bead to enforce postcondition"
   617	                );
   618	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   619	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   620	                    outcome: "success".to_string(),

   471	/// Decision whether to decompose a bead into child beads or refuse decomposition.
   472	///
   473	/// This enum represents the outcome of evaluating whether a bead should be split
   474	/// into smaller child beads via timeout-driven decomposition. The decision is
   475	/// based on clear thresholds and bead characteristics.
   476	#[non_exhaustive]
   477	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   478	pub enum DecompositionDecision {
   479	    /// Split the bead into the proposed child beads.
   480	    ///
   481	    /// This variant contains the proposed child beads that should be created
   482	    /// to complete the original work in smaller, manageable phases.
   483	    Split {
   484	        /// Proposed child beads to create.
   485	        with_proposals: Vec<ChildBeadProposal>,
   486	    },
   487	    /// Refuse to decompose the bead.
   488	    ///
   489	    /// This variant is returned when the bead does not meet the criteria for
   490	    /// decomposition. The refusal reason explains why splitting was not appropriate.
   491	    Refuse {
   492	        /// Human-readable reason for refusal.
   493	        reason: String,
   494	    },
   495	}
   496	
   497	impl DecompositionDecision {
   498	    /// Returns true if this decision is to split.
   499	    pub fn is_split(&self) -> bool {
   500	        matches!(self, DecompositionDecision::Split { .. })
   501	    }
   502	
   503	    /// Returns true if this decision is to refuse decomposition.
   504	    pub fn is_refuse(&self) -> bool {
   505	        matches!(self, DecompositionDecision::Refuse { .. })
   506	    }
   507	
   508	    /// Returns the proposals if this is a Split decision, None otherwise.
   509	    pub fn proposals(&self) -> Option<&Vec<ChildBeadProposal>> {
   510	        match self {
   511	            DecompositionDecision::Split { with_proposals } => Some(with_proposals),
   512	            DecompositionDecision::Refuse { .. } => None,
   513	        }
   514	    }
   515	
   516	    /// Returns the refusal reason if this is a Refuse decision, None otherwise.
   517	    pub fn refusal_reason(&self) -> Option<&String> {
   518	        match self {
   519	            DecompositionDecision::Refuse { reason } => Some(reason),
   520	            DecompositionDecision::Split { .. } => None,
   521	        }
   522	    }
   523	}
   524	
   525	impl fmt::Display for DecompositionDecision {
   526	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
   527	        match self {
   528	            DecompositionDecision::Split { with_proposals } => {
   529	                write!(f, "split into {} child beads", with_proposals.len())
   530	            }
   531	            DecompositionDecision::Refuse { reason } => {
   532	                write!(f, "refuse: {}", reason)
   533	            }
   534	        }
   535	    }
   536	}

   538	/// Configuration for decomposition decision thresholds.
   539	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   540	pub struct DecompositionThresholds {
   541	    /// Minimum timeout (in seconds) required to consider splitting.
   542	    /// Beads that timed out quickly are likely genuine errors, not size issues.
   543	    pub min_timeout_seconds: u64,
   544	    /// Minimum number of retries required to consider splitting.
   545	    /// Beads should be given multiple chances before decomposition.
   546	    pub min_retry_count: u32,
   547	    /// Minimum bead body length (in characters) to consider splitting.
   548	    /// Beads shorter than this are considered "too small" to split meaningfully.
   549	    pub min_bead_size: usize,
   550	    /// Labels that indicate a bead is already a child bead.
   551	    /// Such beads should not be split further to avoid deep nesting.
   552	    pub child_labels: Vec<String>,
   553	}
   554	
   555	impl Default for DecompositionThresholds {
   556	    fn default() -> Self {
   557	        DecompositionThresholds {
   558	            min_timeout_seconds: 300, // 5 minutes
   559	            min_retry_count: 2,       // Must retry at least twice
   560	            min_bead_size: 200,       // At least 200 characters
   561	            child_labels: vec![
   562	                "mitosis-child".to_string(),
   563	                "decomposition-child".to_string(),
   564	            ],
   565	        }
   566	    }
   567	}

   569	/// Evaluate whether a bead should be decomposed into child beads.
   570	///
   571	/// This function implements the decision tree for timeout-driven decomposition.
   572	/// It evaluates bead characteristics against configured thresholds to determine
   573	/// whether splitting is appropriate.
   574	///
   575	/// # Arguments
   576	///
   577	/// * `bead` - The bead to evaluate
   578	/// * `timeout_seconds` - The timeout duration that was exceeded
   579	/// * `retry_count` - Number of consecutive retries for this bead
   580	/// * `thresholds` - Configuration thresholds (uses defaults if None)
   581	///
   582	/// # Returns
   583	///
   584	/// * `DecompositionDecision::Split` - If criteria are met (proposals must be added by caller)
   585	/// * `DecompositionDecision::Refuse` - If criteria are not met
   586	///
   587	/// # Decision Logic
   588	///
   589	/// **Split if ALL of these conditions are met:**
   590	/// - timeout_seconds >= thresholds.min_timeout_seconds
   591	/// - retry_count >= thresholds.min_retry_count
   592	/// - bead body length >= thresholds.min_bead_size
   593	/// - bead has no assignee (not actively being worked)
   594	/// - bead has no child labels (not already a decomposed child)
   595	///
   596	/// **Refuse if ANY of these conditions are met:**
   597	/// - Bead body is too small (< min_bead_size)
   598	/// - Bead has an active assignee
   599	/// - Bead is already a child (has child labels)
   600	/// - Timeout is too short (< min_timeout_seconds)
   601	/// - Not enough retries (< min_retry_count)
   602	///
   603	/// # Examples
   604	///
   605	/// ```no_run
   606	/// use needle::types::{Bead, BeadId, BeadStatus, decompose_bead_decision};
   607	/// use std::path::PathBuf;
   608	/// use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
   609	///
   610	/// let bead = Bead {
   611	///     id: BeadId::from("needle-test"),
   612	///     title: "Test bead".to_string(),
   613	///     body: Some("This is a substantial bead body that exceeds 200 characters...".to_string()),
   614	///     priority: 2,
   615	///     status: BeadStatus::Open,
   616	///     assignee: None,
   617	///     labels: vec![],
   618	///     workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
   619	///     dependencies: vec![],
   620	///     dependents: vec![],
   621	///     comments: vec![],
   622	///     created_at: DateTime::from_timestamp(0, 0).unwrap(),
   623	///     updated_at: DateTime::from_timestamp(0, 0).unwrap(),
   624	/// };
   625	///
   626	/// let decision = decompose_bead_decision(&bead, 600, 3, None);
   627	/// assert!(decision.is_split());
   628	/// ```
   629	pub fn decompose_bead_decision(
   630	    bead: &Bead,
   631	    timeout_seconds: u64,
   632	    retry_count: u32,
   633	    thresholds: Option<DecompositionThresholds>,
   634	) -> DecompositionDecision {
   635	    let thresholds = thresholds.unwrap_or_default();
   636	
   637	    // Check if bead is already a child (has child labels)
   638	    let is_child_bead = bead
   639	        .labels
   640	        .iter()
   641	        .any(|label| thresholds.child_labels.contains(label));
   642	
   643	    if is_child_bead {
   644	        return DecompositionDecision::Refuse {
   645	            reason: format!(
   646	                "bead is already a child bead (has labels: {:?})",
   647	                bead.labels
   648	                    .iter()
   649	                    .filter(|l| thresholds.child_labels.contains(l))
   650	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()

   208	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   209	// Outcome
   210	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   211	
   212	/// The classified outcome of an agent process.
   213	///
   214	/// Every exit code maps to exactly one variant via `Outcome::classify()`.
   215	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   216	pub enum Outcome {
   217	    /// Exit 0 — agent completed work successfully.
   218	    Success,
   219	    /// Non-zero exit indicating a failure (includes app errors 1-99 and unknown codes).
   220	    Failure,
   221	    /// Exit 100 or 124 — timeout wrapper expired.
   222	    Timeout,
   223	    /// Exit 126 or 127 — agent binary not found or not executable.
   224	    AgentNotFound,
   225	    /// Exit 130 (SIGINT) or 143 (SIGTERM) — agent was interrupted.
   226	    Interrupted,
   227	    /// Negative exit code — process crashed or was killed by a signal.
   228	    Crash(i32),
   229	}
   230	
   231	impl Outcome {
   232	    /// Classify an exit code into an `Outcome` variant.
   233	    ///
   234	    /// Every exit code range has an explicit match arm — no wildcards.
   235	    /// The `was_interrupted` flag takes precedence over exit code analysis.
   236	    ///
   237	    /// # Mapping (per spec)
   238	    /// - `was_interrupted=true` → `Interrupted` (checked first)
   239	    /// - exit 0 → `Success`
   240	    /// - exit 1 → `Failure`
   241	    /// - exit 124 → `Timeout`
   242	    /// - exit 127 → `AgentNotFound`
   243	    /// - exit >128 → `Crash(exit_code)`
   244	    /// - exit <0 → `Crash(exit_code)`
   245	    /// - all other → `Failure`
   246	    pub fn classify(exit_code: i32, was_interrupted: bool) -> Self {
   247	        // Interrupted flag takes precedence (graceful shutdown path).
   248	        if was_interrupted {
   249	            return Outcome::Interrupted;
   250	        }
   251	
   252	        // Explicit mapping for every exit code range — NO wildcards.
   253	        // Each range is explicitly enumerated to ensure compile errors
   254	        // if a new Outcome variant is added without updating this match.
   255	        match exit_code {
   256	            // Success
   257	            0 => Outcome::Success,
   258	            // Explicit failure code
   259	            1 => Outcome::Failure,
   260	            // Timeout (GNU timeout exit code)
   261	            124 => Outcome::Timeout,
   262	            // Agent not found (shell exit code for missing command)
   263	            127 => Outcome::AgentNotFound,
   264	            // Failure range: 2-123
   265	            2..=123 => Outcome::Failure,
   266	            // Failure: 125-128 (not >128 per spec, so 128 is not Crash)
   267	            125..=128 => Outcome::Failure,
   268	            // Signal exits: >128 (128 + signal number)
   269	            // These are all crashes per the spec.
   270	            129..=i32::MAX => Outcome::Crash(exit_code),
   271	            // Negative exit codes (abnormal termination)
   272	            i32::MIN..=-1 => Outcome::Crash(exit_code),
   273	        }
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    /// Return a string representation for telemetry/logging.
   277	    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
   278	        match self {
   279	            Outcome::Success => "success",
   280	            Outcome::Failure => "failure",
   281	            Outcome::Timeout => "timeout",
   282	            Outcome::AgentNotFound => "agent_not_found",
   283	            Outcome::Interrupted => "interrupted",
   284	            Outcome::Crash(_) => "crash",
   285	        }
   286	    }
   287	}

   289	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   290	// DecompositionMode
   291	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   292	
   293	/// Mode distinguishing timeout-driven decomposition from ordinary failure handling.
   294	///
   295	/// This enum defines the API boundary between two distinct failure-handling paths:
   296	/// - **Timeout mode**: Activated when a bead times out. The bead is decomposed
   297	///   into smaller child beads via `ChildBeadProposal`, each representing a
   298	///   phase of the original work. This is a recovery strategy for work that
   299	///   exceeded its time budget but may still be completable in smaller pieces.
   300	/// - **OrdinaryFailure mode**: Activated for any non-timeout failure (compilation
   301	///   error, test failure, agent crash, etc.). The bead is NOT decomposed.
   302	///   It is either retried, released, or escalated based on the failure type
   303	///   and consecutive failure count.
   304	///
   305	/// # When to use each mode
   306	///
   307	/// **Use `Timeout` mode when:**
   308	/// - An agent process exits with code 124 (GNU timeout) or times out via another wrapper
   309	/// - The bead has made progress but exceeded its time budget
   310	/// - The work can be meaningfully split into discrete phases
   311	/// - Child beads can complete the work with the same or reduced timeout
   312	///
   313	/// **Use `OrdinaryFailure` mode when:**
   314	/// - Exit codes 1-123, 125-128 (failure codes) or 127 (agent not found)
   315	/// - Exit codes >128 (signal crashes)
   316	/// - Negative exit codes (abnormal termination)
   317	/// - The failure is NOT time-related and splitting won't help
   318	///
   319	/// # API boundary
   320	///
   321	/// This enum is the sole discriminator for whether the decomposition path is
   322	/// activated. No other code should check timeout status or exit codes to make
   323	/// this decision — all decomposition logic should route through this enum.
   324	#[non_exhaustive]
   325	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   326	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
   327	pub enum DecompositionMode {
   328	    /// Timeout-driven decomposition mode.
   329	    ///
   330	    /// Contains timeout-specific context for use in generating child bead
  3040	            min_timeout_seconds: 300,
  3041	            min_retry_count: 2,
  3042	            min_bead_size: 200,
  3043	            child_labels: vec!["custom-child-label".to_string()],
  3044	        };
  3045	
  3046	        let decision = decompose_bead_decision(&bead, 600, 3, Some(custom_thresholds));
  3047	        assert!(decision.is_refuse());
  3048	        assert!(decision
  3049	            .refusal_reason()
  3050	            .unwrap()
  3051	            .contains("already a child"));
  3052	    }
  3053	}

  3111	    /// Action taken on the bead.
  3112	    pub bead_action: BeadAction,
  3113	    /// Telemetry events emitted during handling.
  3114	    pub telemetry_events: Vec<crate::telemetry::EventKind>,
  3115	}
  3116	
  3117	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  3118	// IdentifierScheme
  3119	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  3120	
  3121	/// How workers generate their unique names.
  3122	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
  3123	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
  3124	pub enum IdentifierScheme {
  3125	    /// Use the hostname plus a short random suffix.
  3126	    #[default]
  3127	    HostnameRandom,
  3128	    /// Use a sequential integer suffix.
  3129	    Sequential,
  3130	    /// Use a UUID v4.
   257	    /// Handle a process output for the given bead.
   258	    ///
   259	    /// CRITICAL: For exit code 0, verification gates run BEFORE classification.
   260	    /// This ensures Success means verification passed, not just that the agent exited 0.
   261	    /// An agent that exits 0 but fails verification produces Failure, not Success.
   262	    #[tracing::instrument(
   263	        name = "bead.outcome",
   264	        skip(self, store, bead, output),
   265	        fields(
   266	            needle.bead.id = %bead.id,
   267	            needle.outcome = tracing::field::Empty,
   268	            needle.outcome.action = tracing::field::Empty,
   269	        )
   270	    )]
   271	    pub async fn handle(
   272	        &self,
   273	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   274	        bead: &Bead,
   275	        output: &AgentOutcome,
   276	        was_interrupted: bool,
   277	    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {
   278	        // For exit code 0, run verification BEFORE classification.
   279	        // This is the core fix: Success must mean verification passed.
   280	        let (verified, gate_report) = if output.exit_code == 0 && !was_interrupted {
   281	            self.run_verification_gates(bead).await?
   282	        } else {
   283	            // Non-zero exit or interrupted — verification irrelevant.
   284	            (true, None)
   285	        };
   286	
   287	        let outcome = classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, verified);
   288	
   289	        // Set outcome as span attribute
   290	        tracing::Span::current().record("needle.outcome", outcome.as_str());
   291	
   292	        tracing::info!(
   293	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   294	            exit_code = output.exit_code,
   295	            verified,
   296	            outcome = %outcome,
   297	            "handling agent outcome"
   298	        );
   299	
   300	        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.
   301	        // This prevents worker hang in HANDLING state when telemetry is wedged.
   302	        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeClassified {
   303	            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   304	            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),
   305	            exit_code: output.exit_code,
   306	        });
   307	
   308	        let (bead_action, telemetry_events) = match outcome.clone() {
   309	            Outcome::Success => self.handle_success(store, bead, gate_report).await?,
   310	            Outcome::Failure => {
   311	                // If we have a gate report with failures, handle as gate failure.
   312	                if let Some(report) = gate_report {
   313	                    if !report.all_passed {
   314	                        self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await?
   315	                    } else {
   316	                        self.handle_failure(store, bead).await?
   317	                    }
   318	                } else {
   319	                    self.handle_failure(store, bead).await?
   320	                }
   321	            }
   322	            Outcome::Timeout => self.handle_timeout(store, bead).await?,
   323	            Outcome::AgentNotFound => self.handle_agent_not_found(store, bead).await?,
   324	            Outcome::Interrupted => self.handle_interrupted(store, bead).await?,
   325	            Outcome::Crash(code) => self.handle_crash(store, bead, code).await?,
   326	        };
   327	
   328	        // Emit sub-handler events (e.g. BeadCompleted, BeadOrphaned) to the
   329	        // telemetry sink so they appear in the JSONL log.
   330	        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.
   331	        for event in &telemetry_events {
   332	            let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(event.clone());
   333	        }
   334	
   335	        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.
   336	        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeHandled {
   337	            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   338	            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),
   339	            action: bead_action.to_string(),
   340	        });
   341	
   342	        // Set action as span attribute
   343	        tracing::Span::current().record("needle.outcome.action", bead_action.to_string());
   344	
   345	        // Set span status: Ok for success, Error otherwise
   346	        if !matches!(outcome, Outcome::Success) {
   347	            tracing::Span::current().record("otel.status_code", 2u64);
   348	            tracing::Span::current().record("otel.status_description", outcome.as_str());
   349	        }
   350	
   351	        Ok(HandlerResult {
   352	            outcome,
   353	            bead_action,
   354	            telemetry_events,
   355	        })
   356	    }
   357	
   358	    /// Handle a process output with cancellation support.
   359	    ///
   360	    /// Checks the cancellation flag before starting the handler and returns
   361	    /// early if the handler has been cancelled (e.g., due to a timeout in
   362	    /// the worker). This prevents the handler from making further br calls
   363	    /// after a timeout has occurred.
   364	    pub async fn handle_with_cancellation(
   365	        &self,
   366	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   367	        bead: &Bead,
   368	        output: &AgentOutcome,
   369	        was_interrupted: bool,
   370	        cancelled: Arc<AtomicBool>,
   371	    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {
   372	        // Check if we've been cancelled before starting.
   373	        if cancelled.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
   374	            tracing::warn!(
   375	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   376	                "outcome handler cancelled before starting, returning early"
   377	            );
   378	            // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.
   379	            // Verification never ran, so conservatively treat as unverified.
   380	            return Ok(HandlerResult {
   381	                outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false),
   382	                bead_action: BeadAction::None,
   383	                telemetry_events: vec![],
   384	            });
   385	        }
   386	
   387	        // Wrap the handler in a timeout to prevent indefinite hangs.
   388	        // This is a safety net in case the internal br call timeouts don't work.
   389	        // Configurable via `validation.outcome_timeout_seconds` (default 50) —
   390	        // see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#8: a gate running a real verification
   391	        // workload (container test suite, secret scan, fresh-model diff verifier)
   392	        // needs minutes, not seconds.
   393	        let bead_id = bead.id.clone();
   394	        let telemetry = self.telemetry.clone();
   395	        let timeout_secs = self.config.validation.outcome_timeout_seconds;
   396	
   397	        match tokio::time::timeout(
   398	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs),
   399	            self.handle(store, bead, output, was_interrupted),
   400	        )
   401	        .await
   402	        {
   403	            Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(result),
   404	            Ok(Err(e)) => {
   405	                // Handler returned an error.
   406	                tracing::error!(
   407	                    bead_id = %bead_id,
   408	                    error = %e,
   409	                    "outcome handler returned error"
   410	                );
   411	                Err(e)
   412	            }
   413	            Err(_) => {
   414	                // Timeout after `timeout_secs` seconds.
   415	                tracing::error!(
   416	                    bead_id = %bead_id,
   417	                    timeout_secs,
   418	                    "outcome handler timed out, returning early to allow worker recovery"
   419	                );
   420	                // Emit a timeout event for observability.
   421	                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   422	                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),
   423	                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false)
   424	                        .as_str()
   425	                        .to_string(),
   426	                    operation: "handle".to_string(),
   427	                    error: format!("timeout after {}s", timeout_secs),
   428	                });
   429	                // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.
   430	                // The worker's 60-second timeout wrapper will handle best-effort release.
   431	                // Verification never ran, so conservatively treat as unverified.
   432	                Ok(HandlerResult {
   433	                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false),
   434	                    bead_action: BeadAction::Released,
   435	                    telemetry_events: vec![EventKind::BeadReleased {
   436	                        bead_id,
   437	                        reason: "handler_timeout".to_string(),
   438	                    }],
   439	                })
   440	            }
   441	        }
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    /// Success: verification already passed, now verify bead closure.
   445	    ///
   446	    /// CRITICAL: This is only called when verification PASSED.
   447	    /// If verification failed, classification produces Failure and handle_failure
   448	    /// is called instead. This ensures Success means verification passed.
   449	    ///
   450	    /// Flow:
   451	    /// 1. If gates ran, emit VerificationPassed telemetry.
   452	    /// 2. Check if agent closed the bead.
   453	    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.
   454	    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.
   455	    ///
   456	    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.
   457	    async fn handle_success(
   458	        &self,
   459	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   460	        bead: &Bead,
   461	        gate_report: Option<GateReport>,
   462	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   463	        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent completed successfully");
   464	
   465	        // If gates ran and passed, emit telemetry.
   466	        if let Some(report) = gate_report {
   467	            let gates_run = report.results.len() as u32;
   468	            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationPassed {
   469	                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   470	                gates_run,
   450	    /// Flow:
   451	    /// 1. If gates ran, emit VerificationPassed telemetry.
   452	    /// 2. Check if agent closed the bead.
   453	    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.
   454	    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.
   455	    ///
   456	    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.
   457	    async fn handle_success(
   458	        &self,
   459	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   460	        bead: &Bead,
   461	        gate_report: Option<GateReport>,
   462	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   463	        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent completed successfully");
   464	
   465	        // If gates ran and passed, emit telemetry.
   466	        if let Some(report) = gate_report {
   467	            let gates_run = report.results.len() as u32;
   468	            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationPassed {
   469	                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   470	                gates_run,
   471	            })?;
   472	            tracing::info!(
   473	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   474	                gates_run,
   475	                "all validation gates passed"
   476	            );
   477	        }
   478	
   479	        // Reset failure count on successful gate completion.
   480	        // This ensures the bead starts fresh on the next cycle if re-claimed.
   481	        let _ = self.reset_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   482	
   483	        // Normal success flow: check if agent closed the bead.
   484	        let mut events = Vec::new();
   485	
   486	        // Use timeout for show() to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.
   487	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), "show").await {
   488	            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {
   489	                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {
   490	                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {
   491	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   492	                            tracing::warn!(
   493	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   494	                                reason = %reason,
   495	                                "bead closed but shipped-work check failed — reopening and releasing"
   496	                            );
   497	                            let report = GateReport::single_failure("shipped_work", reason);
   498	                            return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;
   499	                        }
   500	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {}
   501	                        Err(e) => {
   502	                            tracing::warn!(
   503	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   504	                                error = %e,
   505	                                "shipped-work check errored — failing open"
   506	                            );
   507	                        }
   508	                    }
   509	                }
   510	
   511	                // Dispatch is fully accounted for — drop its snapshot so the
   512	                // next claim of this bead starts from a fresh baseline.
   513	                crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   514	
   515	                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "bead confirmed closed by agent");
   516	                events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   517	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   518	                    duration_ms: 0,
   519	                });
   520	                // Increment success_count for any skills that matched this bead.
   521	                if !bead.workspace.as_os_str().is_empty() {
   522	                    if let Ok(lib) = crate::skill::SkillLibrary::load(&bead.workspace) {
   523	                        if let Err(e) = lib.increment_success_for_bead(&bead.labels, &bead.title) {
   524	                            tracing::warn!(
   525	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   526	                                error = %e,
   527	                                "failed to increment skill success counts"
   528	                            );
   529	                        }
   530	                    }
   531	                }
   532	            }
   533	            Ok(Some(current)) => {
   534	                tracing::warn!(
   535	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   536	                    status = %current.status,
   537	                    "agent exited successfully but bead is still open (orphaned)"
   538	                );
   539	                events.push(EventKind::BeadOrphaned {
   540	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   541	                });
   542	
   543	                // Use verify_shipped_work to decide close-vs-release.
   544	                // If the agent shipped work, mark as completed. Otherwise, release
   545	                // and increment failure count so repeat offenders quarantine.
   546	                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {
   547	                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {
   548	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {
   549	                            tracing::info!(
   550	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   551	                                "shipped work detected — marking orphaned bead as completed"
   552	                            );
   553	                            // Clear the predispatch snapshot since work is complete.
   554	                            crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   555	                            // Mark as completed - the agent shipped work but forgot to close.
   556	                            // We can't close via bead store (no close method), so emit completion
   557	                            // event and release. The bead remains open but work is done.
   558	                            events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   559	                                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   560	                                duration_ms: 0,
   561	                            });
   562	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   563	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   564	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   565	                        }
   566	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   567	                            tracing::warn!(
   568	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   569	                                reason = %reason,
   570	                                "no shipped work detected — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   571	                            );
   572	                            // Release and increment failure count to apply quarantine.
   573	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   574	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   575	                            let release_succeeded = events
   576	                                .iter()
   577	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   578	                            if release_succeeded {
   579	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   580	                            }
   581	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   582	                        }
   583	                        Err(e) => {
   584	                            tracing::warn!(
   585	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   586	                                error = %e,
   587	                                "shipped-work check errored — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   588	                            );
   589	                            // On error, release and increment failure count.
   590	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   591	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   592	                            let release_succeeded = events
   593	                                .iter()
   594	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   595	                            if release_succeeded {
   596	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   597	                            }
   598	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   599	                        }
   600	                    }
   601	                } else {
   602	                    tracing::warn!(
   603	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   604	                        "enforce_shipped_work disabled — releasing orphaned bead"
   605	                    );
   606	                    // If enforce_shipped_work is disabled, just release without closing.
   607	                    let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   608	                    events.append(&mut release_events);
   609	                    return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   610	                }
   611	            }
   612	            Ok(None) => {
   613	                // Timeout - we cannot verify bead closure, so release to enforce postcondition.
   614	                tracing::warn!(
   615	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   616	                    "show() timed out, releasing bead to enforce postcondition"
   617	                );
   618	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   619	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   620	                    outcome: "success".to_string(),
   621	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   622	                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
   623	                });
   624	                let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   625	                events.append(&mut release_events);
   626	                return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   627	            }
   628	            Err(e) => {
   629	                // Error - we cannot verify bead closure, so release to enforce postcondition.
   630	                tracing::warn!(
   631	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   632	                    error = %e,
   633	                    "show() failed, releasing bead to enforce postcondition"
   634	                );
   635	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   636	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   637	                    outcome: "success".to_string(),
   638	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   639	                    error: e.to_string(),
   640	                });
   641	                let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   642	                events.append(&mut release_events);
   643	                return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   644	            }
   645	        }
   646	
   647	        // Flush SQLite state to JSONL so the closed/orphaned bead is captured in
   648	        // the git-committed backup. Non-fatal: a flush failure is logged but does
   649	        // not block the worker from picking up the next bead.
   650	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.flush(), "flush").await {
   651	            Ok(Some(())) => {
   652	                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, "flushed bead state to JSONL after success");
   653	            }
   654	            Ok(None) => {
   655	                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "flush timed out after success — JSONL may lag SQLite");
   656	            }
   657	            Err(e) => {
   658	                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, error = %e, "flush failed after success — JSONL may lag SQLite");
   659	            }
   660	        }
   661	
   662	        Ok((BeadAction::None, events))
   663	    }
   664	
   665	    /// Handle gate failure: reopen the bead if it was closed, then release it.
   666	    async fn handle_gate_failure(
   667	        &self,
   668	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   669	        bead: &Bead,
   670	        report: &crate::validation::GateReport,
   671	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   672	        // Find the first failing gate for telemetry.
   673	        let (failed_gate, reason) = report
   674	            .results
   675	            .iter()
   676	            .find(|(_, r)| !r.passed())
   677	            .map(|(name, r)| (name.clone(), r.failure_reason().unwrap_or("").to_string()))
   678	            .unwrap_or_else(|| ("unknown".to_string(), "unknown error".to_string()));
   679	
   680	        tracing::warn!(
   681	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   682	            gate = %failed_gate,
   683	            reason = %reason,
   684	            "validation gate failed — releasing bead"
   685	        );
   686	
   687	        // Emit verification failure telemetry.
   688	        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationFailed {
   689	            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   690	            command: failed_gate.clone(),
   691	            exit_code: None,
   692	            output: reason,
   693	        })?;
   694	
   695	        let mut events = Vec::new();
   696	
   697	        // If the agent already closed the bead, reopen it before releasing.
   698	        // Use timeout to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.
   699	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), "show").await {
   700	            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {
   701	                tracing::info!(
   702	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   703	                    "reopening bead closed by agent (verification failed)"
   704	                );
   705	                match self.timeout_op(|| store.reopen(&bead.id), "reopen").await {
   706	                    Ok(_) => {}
   707	                    Err(e) => {
   708	                        tracing::warn!(
   709	                            bead_id = %bead.id,
   710	                            error = %e,
   711	                            "failed to reopen bead — attempting release anyway"
   712	                        );
   713	                        events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   714	                            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   715	                            outcome: "gate_failure".to_string(),
   716	                            operation: "reopen".to_string(),
   717	                            error: e.to_string(),
   718	                        });
   719	                    }
   720	                }
   721	            }
   722	            Ok(None) => {
   723	                tracing::warn!(
   724	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   725	                    "show() timed out during gate failure handling, skipping reopen"
   726	                );
   727	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   728	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   729	                    outcome: "gate_failure".to_string(),
   730	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   731	                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
   732	                });
   733	            }
   734	            Err(e) => {
   735	                tracing::warn!(
   736	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   737	                    error = %e,
   738	                    "show() failed during gate failure handling"
   739	                );
   740	            }
   741	            _ => {}
   742	        }
   743	
   744	        // Release the bead back to open with flush-before-release and sync recovery.
   745	        let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   746	        events.append(&mut release_events);
   747	
   748	        // If release succeeded, increment the failure count and apply the same
   749	        // quarantine ceiling `handle_failure` uses. Without this, a bead that
   750	        // fails a gate every cycle is released back to open forever: the
   751	        // ARMOR/bf-135k storm ran one bead 24 times in a single day, each
   752	        // attempt leaving another commit behind. A gate failure is no less
   753	        // repeatable than an agent failure and must respect the same ceiling.
   754	        let release_succeeded = events
   755	            .iter()
   756	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   757	        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;
   758	        if release_succeeded {
   759	            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   760	                Ok(new_count) => {
   761	                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;
   762	                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {
   763	                        match self
   764	                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)
   765	                            .await
   766	                        {
   767	                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {
   768	                                events.extend(quarantine_events);
   769	                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;
   770	                            }
   771	                            Err(e) => {
   772	                                tracing::warn!(
   773	                                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   774	                                    error = %e,
   775	                                    "failed to quarantine bead after exceeding gate-failure threshold"
   776	                                );
   777	                            }
   778	                        }
   779	                    }
   780	                }
   781	                Err(e) => {
   782	                    tracing::warn!(
   783	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   784	                        error = %e,
   785	                        "failed to increment failure count after gate failure"
   786	                    );
   787	                }
   788	            }
   789	        }
   790	
   791	        // Add a label indicating verification failure.
   792	        if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(
   793	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   794	            store.add_label(&bead.id, "verification-failed"),
   795	        )
   796	        .await
   797	        {
   798	            tracing::warn!(
   799	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   800	                error = %e,
   801	                "failed to add verification-failed label"
   802	            );
   803	        }
   804	
   805	        Ok((action, events))
   806	    }
   807	
   808	    /// Failure: release bead and increment failure count.
   809	    ///
   810	    /// Mitosis evaluation (for multi-task splitting) is handled externally by
   811	    /// the worker after outcome handling — see `MitosisEvaluator`.
   812	    ///
   813	    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not
   814	    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.
   815	    async fn handle_failure(
   816	        &self,
   817	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   818	        bead: &Bead,
   819	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   820	        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent failure — releasing bead");
   821	
   822	        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   823	
   824	        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and check the
   825	        // quarantine threshold. A bead that has exceeded
   826	        // `outcome.quarantine_after_failures` consecutive failures is
   827	        // quarantined (status=blocked) instead of being left released-to-open
   828	        // for the next cycle to re-claim and fail again indefinitely. This
   829	        // also closes the mitosis `NotSplittable` fallthrough (worker/mod.rs):
   830	        // that verdict no longer matters for beads at or past the ceiling,
   831	        // since this check already ran before mitosis evaluation this cycle.
   832	        let release_succeeded = events
   833	            .iter()
   834	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   835	        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;
   836	        if release_succeeded {
   837	            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   838	                Ok(new_count) => {
   839	                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;
   840	                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {
   841	                        match self
   842	                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)
   843	                            .await
   844	                        {
   845	                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {
   846	                                events.extend(quarantine_events);
   847	                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;
   848	                            }
   849	                            Err(e) => {
   850	                                tracing::warn!(
   851	                                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   852	                                    error = %e,
   853	                                    "failed to quarantine bead after exceeding failure threshold"
   854	                                );
   855	                            }
   856	                        }
   857	                    }
   858	                }
   859	                Err(e) => {
   860	                    tracing::warn!(
   861	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   862	                        error = %e,
   863	                        "failed to increment failure count after release"
   864	                    );
   865	                }
   866	            }
   867	        }
   868	
   869	        // Ensure we emit a reason event for telemetry.
   870	        if !events.iter().any(|e| {
   871	            matches!(
   872	                e,
   873	                EventKind::BeadReleased { .. } | EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { .. }
   874	            )
   875	        }) {
   876	            events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {
   877	                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   878	                reason: "failure".to_string(),
   879	            });
   880	        }
   881	
   882	        Ok((action, events))
   883	    }
   884	
   885	    /// Timeout: release bead and add `deferred` label.
   886	    ///
   887	    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not
   888	    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.
   889	    async fn handle_timeout(
   890	        &self,
   891	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   892	        bead: &Bead,
   893	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   894	        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent timed out — releasing bead as deferred");
   895	
   896	        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   897	
   898	        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and add deferred label.
   899	        let release_succeeded = events
   900	            .iter()
   901	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   902	        if release_succeeded {
   903	            // Increment failure count for auto-split tracking.
   904	            if let Err(e) = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   905	                tracing::warn!(
   906	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   907	                    error = %e,
   908	                    "failed to increment failure count after timeout"
   909	                );
   910	            }
   911	
   912	            if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(
   913	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   914	                store.add_label(&bead.id, "deferred"),
   915	            )
   916	            .await
   917	            {
   918	                tracing::warn!(
   919	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   920	                    error = %e,
   921	                    "add_label deferred timed out or failed after timeout release"
   922	                );
   923	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   924	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   925	                    outcome: "timeout".to_string(),
   926	                    operation: "add_label".to_string(),
   927	                    error: e.to_string(),
   928	                });
   929	            }
   930	        }
   931	
   932	        Ok((BeadAction::Deferred, events))
   933	    }
   934	
   935	    /// Crash: release bead and create alert bead with diagnostic info.
   936	    async fn handle_crash(
   937	        &self,
   938	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   939	        bead: &Bead,
   940	        signal_code: i32,
   941	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   942	        tracing::error!(
   943	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   944	            signal_code,
   945	            agent = %self.config.agent.default,
   946	            "agent crashed — releasing bead and creating alert"
   947	        );
   948	
   949	        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   950	
   951	        // Create alert bead with diagnostic info (best-effort).
   952	        let signal_num = if signal_code > 128 {
   953	            signal_code - 128
   954	        } else {
   955	            signal_code
   956	        };
   957	        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
   958	        let alert_title = format!("ALERT: Agent crash on bead {}", bead.id);
   959	        let alert_body = format!(
   960	            "## Agent Crash Report\n\
   961	             \n\
   962	             - **Bead ID**: {}\n\
   963	             - **Agent**: {}\n\
   964	             - **Exit code**: {} (signal {})\n\
   965	             - **Workspace**: {}\n\
   966	             - **Timestamp**: {}\n\
   967	             \n\
   968	             The agent process was killed. This bead has been released for retry.",
   969	            bead.id,
   970	            self.config.agent.default,
   971	            signal_code,
   972	            signal_num,
   973	            bead.workspace.display(),
   974	            timestamp,
   975	        );
   976	
   977	        // Hook 4: propagate stitch labels from the crashed bead to the alert.
   978	        let signal_label = format!("signal-{}", signal_num);
   979	        let mut alert_labels: Vec<String> = vec!["alert".into(), "crash".into(), signal_label];
   980	        alert_labels.extend(crate::types::extract_stitch_labels(&bead.labels));
   981	        let alert_label_refs: Vec<&str> = alert_labels.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
   982	        match tokio::time::timeout(
   983	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   984	            store.create_bead(&alert_title, &alert_body, &alert_label_refs),
   985	        )
   986	        .await
   987	        {
   988	            Ok(Ok(alert_id)) => {
   989	                tracing::info!(
   990	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   991	                    %alert_id,
   992	                    "crash alert bead created"
   993	                );
   994	            }
   995	            Ok(Err(e)) => {
   996	                tracing::warn!(
   997	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   998	                    error = %e,
   999	                    "failed to create crash alert bead"
  1000	                );
  1001	            }
  1002	            Err(_) => {
  1003	                tracing::warn!(
  1004	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
  1005	                    "create_bead timed out after 30s during crash handling"
  1006	                );
  1007	            }
  1008	        }
  1009	
  1010	        Ok((BeadAction::Alerted, events))
  1011	    }
  1012	
  1013	    /// AgentNotFound: release bead, emit error. No retry — this is a config issue.
  1014	    async fn handle_agent_not_found(
  1015	        &self,
  1016	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
  1017	        bead: &Bead,
  1018	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
  1019	        tracing::error!(
  1020	            bead_id = %bead.id,
  1021	            agent = %self.config.agent.default,
  1022	            "agent binary not found — releasing bead (config issue, no retry)"
  1023	        );
  1024	
  1025	        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
  1026	        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))
  1027	    }
  1028	
  1029	    /// Interrupted: release bead for graceful shutdown.
  1030	    async fn handle_interrupted(
  1031	        &self,
  1032	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
  1033	        bead: &Bead,
  1034	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
  1035	        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent interrupted — releasing bead for clean shutdown");
  1036	
  1037	        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
  1038	        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))
  1039	    }

  1041	    /// Increment the failure count label on a bead.
  1042	    ///
  1043	    /// Labels follow the pattern `failure-count:N`. If `failure-count:2` exists,
  1044	    /// the old label is removed and `failure-count:3` is added.
  1045	    ///
  1046	    /// Returns the new failure count (or 0 if the operation failed).
  1047	    ///
  1048	    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in
  1049	    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.
  1050	    async fn increment_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<u32> {
  1051	        // Read labels with timeout.
  1052	        let labels =
  1053	            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(&bead.id))
  1054	                .await
  1055	            {
  1056	                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,
  1057	                Ok(Err(e)) => {
  1058	                    tracing::warn!(
  1059	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
  1060	                        error = %e,
  2750	                .await;
  2751	                // Force transition to LOGGING to recover.
  2752	                self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging)?;
  2753	                return Ok(());
  2754	            }
  2755	        };
  2756	
  2757	        // Check if the watchdog triggered during HANDLING state.
  2758	        // This can happen if the heartbeat task detected the watchdog trigger and
  2759	        // set the cancelled flag, or if the watchdog thread set the flag directly.
  2760	        if self.watchdog_triggered.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
  2761	            tracing::error!(
  2762	                bead_id = %bead.id,
  2763	                "watchdog detected during HANDLING state, forcing recovery to LOGGING"
  2764	            );
  2765	            // Clear the watchdog trigger.
  2766	            self.watchdog_triggered.store(false, Ordering::Release);
  2767	            self.handling_state_entered_at = None;

  2769	            let _ = self
  2770	                .telemetry
  2771	                .emit_try_lock(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {

  2774	                    operation: "watchdog".to_string(),
  2775	                    error: format!(
  2776	                        "HANDLING state exceeded {}s timeout",
  2777	                        HANDLING_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SECS

  2781	            self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging)?;
  2782	            // Stop the heartbeat task.

  2795	            let outcome_str = handler_result.outcome.as_str();
  2796	            let event_name = match &handler_result.outcome {
  2797	                crate::types::Outcome::Success => "complete",
  2798	                crate::types::Outcome::Failure | crate::types::Outcome::AgentNotFound => "fail",
  2799	                crate::types::Outcome::Timeout => "timeout",
  2800	                crate::types::Outcome::Crash(_) => "crash",
  2801	                crate::types::Outcome::Interrupted => "release",
  2802	            };

  2805	                "exit_code": output.exit_code,

  2812	                &self.worker_name,

  2816	                extra,
  2817	            );
  2818	        }
  2819	
  2820	        // Emit a heartbeat after the outcome handler completes to signal we're
  2821	        // still alive. This helps detect hangs in post-handler code (commit hook,
  2822	        // mitosis, state transitions) that occur after the handler finishes.
  2823	        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.
  2824	        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {
  2825	            bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),
  2826	            state: "HANDLING_POST_HANDLER".to_string(),
  2827	        });
  2828	
  2829	        // Evaluate for mitosis after failure — the bead has already been
  2830	        // released and failure count incremented by the outcome handler.
  2831	        if handler_result.outcome == Outcome::Failure {
  2832	            let workspace = if is_workspace_unset(&bead.workspace) {

  2834	            } else {
  2835	                bead.workspace.clone()
  2836	            };
  2837

  2842	                needle.mitosis.result = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on evaluation result
  2843	            );
