  2932	            let duration = self
  2933	                .last_effort
  2934	                .as_ref()
  2935	                .map(|effort| effort.cycle_start.elapsed())
  2936	                .unwrap_or(std::time::Duration::from_secs(0));
  2937	
  2938	            // Build AgentOutcome from the last execution result
  2939	            // Note: we don't track stdout/stderr in EffortData, so use empty strings
  2940	            let agent_outcome = crate::types::AgentOutcome {
  2941	                exit_code: 124, // SIGTERM exit code for timeout
  2942	                stdout: String::new(),
  2943	                stderr: String::new(),
  2944	            };
  2945	
  2946	            // Wrap timeout mitosis evaluation in timeout to prevent indefinite hang.
  2947	            async {
  2948	                match tokio::time::timeout(
  2949	                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(120),
  2950	                    self.mitosis_evaluator.evaluate_timeout(
  2951	                        self.store.as_ref(),
  2952	                        &bead,
  2953	                        &workspace,
  2954	                        &self.dispatcher,
  2955	                        &self.prompt_builder,
  2956	                        &self.config.agent.default,
  2957	                        &agent_outcome,
  2958	                        duration,
  2959	                    ),
  2960	                )
  2961	                .await
  2962	                {
  2963	                Ok(Ok(crate::mitosis::MitosisResult::Split { children })) => {
  2964	                    tracing::Span::current().record("needle.mitosis.result", "split");
  2965	                    tracing::info!(
  2966	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
  2967	                        children = children.len(),
  2968	                        "timeout mitosis created child beads — parent blocked"
  2969	                    );
  2970	                }
  2971	                Ok(Ok(crate::mitosis::MitosisResult::NotSplittable)) => {
  2972	                    tracing::Span::current().record("needle.mitosis.result", "not_splittable");
  2973	                    tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, "timeout mitosis: bead is single task or unsafe to split");
  2974	                }
  2975	                Ok(Ok(crate::mitosis::MitosisResult::Skipped { reason })) => {
   350	
   351	        Ok(HandlerResult {
   352	            outcome,
   353	            bead_action,
   354	            telemetry_events,
   355	        })
   356	    }
   357	
   358	    /// Handle a process output with cancellation support.
   359	    ///
   360	    /// Checks the cancellation flag before starting the handler and returns
   361	    /// early if the handler has been cancelled (e.g., due to a timeout in
   362	    /// the worker). This prevents the handler from making further br calls
   363	    /// after a timeout has occurred.
   364	    pub async fn handle_with_cancellation(
   365	        &self,
   366	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   367	        bead: &Bead,
   368	        output: &AgentOutcome,
   369	        was_interrupted: bool,
   370	        cancelled: Arc<AtomicBool>,
   371	    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {
   372	        // Check if we've been cancelled before starting.
   373	        if cancelled.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
   374	            tracing::warn!(
   375	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   376	                "outcome handler cancelled before starting, returning early"
   377	            );
   378	            // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.
   379	            // Verification never ran, so conservatively treat as unverified.
   380	            return Ok(HandlerResult {
   381	                outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false),
   382	                bead_action: BeadAction::None,
   383	                telemetry_events: vec![],
   384	            });
   385	        }
   386	
   387	        // Wrap the handler in a timeout to prevent indefinite hangs.
   388	        // This is a safety net in case the internal br call timeouts don't work.
   389	        // Configurable via `validation.outcome_timeout_seconds` (default 50) —
   390	        // see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#8: a gate running a real verification
   391	        // workload (container test suite, secret scan, fresh-model diff verifier)
   392	        // needs minutes, not seconds.
   393	        let bead_id = bead.id.clone();
   394	        let telemetry = self.telemetry.clone();
   395	        let timeout_secs = self.config.validation.outcome_timeout_seconds;
   396	
   397	        match tokio::time::timeout(
   398	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs),
   399	            self.handle(store, bead, output, was_interrupted),
   400	        )
   401	        .await
   402	        {
   403	            Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(result),
   404	            Ok(Err(e)) => {
   405	                // Handler returned an error.
   406	                tracing::error!(
   407	                    bead_id = %bead_id,
   408	                    error = %e,
   409	                    "outcome handler returned error"
   410	                );
   411	                Err(e)
   412	            }
   413	            Err(_) => {
   414	                // Timeout after `timeout_secs` seconds.
   415	                tracing::error!(
   416	                    bead_id = %bead_id,
   417	                    timeout_secs,
   418	                    "outcome handler timed out, returning early to allow worker recovery"
   419	                );
   420	                // Emit a timeout event for observability.
   421	                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   422	                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),
   423	                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false)
   424	                        .as_str()
   425	                        .to_string(),
   426	                    operation: "handle".to_string(),
   427	                    error: format!("timeout after {}s", timeout_secs),
   428	                });
   429	                // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.
   430	                // The worker's 60-second timeout wrapper will handle best-effort release.
   431	                // Verification never ran, so conservatively treat as unverified.
   432	                Ok(HandlerResult {
   433	                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted, false),
   434	                    bead_action: BeadAction::Released,
   435	                    telemetry_events: vec![EventKind::BeadReleased {
   436	                        bead_id,
   437	                        reason: "handler_timeout".to_string(),
   438	                    }],
   439	                })
   440	            }
   441	        }
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    /// Success: verification already passed, now verify bead closure.
   445	    ///
   446	    /// CRITICAL: This is only called when verification PASSED.
   447	    /// If verification failed, classification produces Failure and handle_failure
   448	    /// is called instead. This ensures Success means verification passed.
   449	    ///
   450	    /// Flow:
   451	    /// 1. If gates ran, emit VerificationPassed telemetry.
   452	    /// 2. Check if agent closed the bead.
   453	    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.
   454	    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.
   455	    ///
   456	    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.
   457	    async fn handle_success(
   458	        &self,
   459	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   460	        bead: &Bead,
   450	    /// Flow:
   451	    /// 1. If gates ran, emit VerificationPassed telemetry.
   452	    /// 2. Check if agent closed the bead.
   453	    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.
   454	    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.
   455	    ///
   456	    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.
   457	    async fn handle_success(
   458	        &self,
   459	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   460	        bead: &Bead,
   461	        gate_report: Option<GateReport>,
   462	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   463	        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent completed successfully");
   464	
   465	        // If gates ran and passed, emit telemetry.
   466	        if let Some(report) = gate_report {
   467	            let gates_run = report.results.len() as u32;
   468	            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationPassed {
   469	                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   470	                gates_run,
   471	            })?;
   472	            tracing::info!(
   473	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   474	                gates_run,
   475	                "all validation gates passed"
   476	            );
   477	        }
   478	
   479	        // Reset failure count on successful gate completion.
   480	        // This ensures the bead starts fresh on the next cycle if re-claimed.
   481	        let _ = self.reset_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   482	
   483	        // Normal success flow: check if agent closed the bead.
   484	        let mut events = Vec::new();
   485	
   486	        // Use timeout for show() to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.
   487	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), "show").await {
   488	            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {
   489	                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {
   490	                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {
   491	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   492	                            tracing::warn!(
   493	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   494	                                reason = %reason,
   495	                                "bead closed but shipped-work check failed — reopening and releasing"
   496	                            );
   497	                            let report = GateReport::single_failure("shipped_work", reason);
   498	                            return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;
   499	                        }
   500	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {}
   501	                        Err(e) => {
   502	                            tracing::warn!(
   503	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   504	                                error = %e,
   505	                                "shipped-work check errored — failing open"
   506	                            );
   507	                        }
   508	                    }
   509	                }
   510	
   511	                // Dispatch is fully accounted for — drop its snapshot so the
   512	                // next claim of this bead starts from a fresh baseline.
   513	                crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   514	
   515	                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, "bead confirmed closed by agent");
   516	                events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   517	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   518	                    duration_ms: 0,
   519	                });
   520	                // Increment success_count for any skills that matched this bead.
   521	                if !bead.workspace.as_os_str().is_empty() {
   522	                    if let Ok(lib) = crate::skill::SkillLibrary::load(&bead.workspace) {
   523	                        if let Err(e) = lib.increment_success_for_bead(&bead.labels, &bead.title) {
   524	                            tracing::warn!(
   525	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   526	                                error = %e,
   527	                                "failed to increment skill success counts"
   528	                            );
   529	                        }
   530	                    }
   531	                }
   532	            }
   533	            Ok(Some(current)) => {
   534	                tracing::warn!(
   535	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   536	                    status = %current.status,
   537	                    "agent exited successfully but bead is still open (orphaned)"
   538	                );
   539	                events.push(EventKind::BeadOrphaned {
   540	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   541	                });
   542	
   543	                // Use verify_shipped_work to decide close-vs-release.
   544	                // If the agent shipped work, mark as completed. Otherwise, release
   545	                // and increment failure count so repeat offenders quarantine.
   546	                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {
   547	                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {
   548	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {
   549	                            tracing::info!(
   550	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   551	                                "shipped work detected — marking orphaned bead as completed"
   552	                            );
   553	                            // Clear the predispatch snapshot since work is complete.
   554	                            crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;
   555	                            // Mark as completed - the agent shipped work but forgot to close.
   556	                            // We can't close via bead store (no close method), so emit completion
   557	                            // event and release. The bead remains open but work is done.
   558	                            events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {
   559	                                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   560	                                duration_ms: 0,
   561	                            });
   562	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   563	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   564	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   565	                        }
   566	                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {
   567	                            tracing::warn!(
   568	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   569	                                reason = %reason,
   570	                                "no shipped work detected — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   571	                            );
   572	                            // Release and increment failure count to apply quarantine.
   573	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   574	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   575	                            let release_succeeded = events
   576	                                .iter()
   577	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   578	                            if release_succeeded {
   579	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   580	                            }
   581	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   582	                        }
   583	                        Err(e) => {
   584	                            tracing::warn!(
   585	                                bead_id = %bead.id,
   586	                                error = %e,
   587	                                "shipped-work check errored — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment"
   588	                            );
   589	                            // On error, release and increment failure count.
   590	                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   591	                            events.append(&mut release_events);
   592	                            let release_succeeded = events
   593	                                .iter()
   594	                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   595	                            if release_succeeded {
   596	                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;
   597	                            }
   598	                            return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   599	                        }
   600	                    }
   601	                } else {
   602	                    tracing::warn!(
   603	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   604	                        "enforce_shipped_work disabled — releasing orphaned bead"
   605	                    );
   606	                    // If enforce_shipped_work is disabled, just release without closing.
   607	                    let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   608	                    events.append(&mut release_events);
   609	                    return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   610	                }
   611	            }
   612	            Ok(None) => {
   613	                // Timeout - we cannot verify bead closure, so release to enforce postcondition.
   614	                tracing::warn!(
   615	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   616	                    "show() timed out, releasing bead to enforce postcondition"
   617	                );
   618	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   619	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   620	                    outcome: "success".to_string(),
   621	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   622	                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
   623	                });
   624	                let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   625	                events.append(&mut release_events);
   626	                return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   627	            }
   628	            Err(e) => {
   629	                // Error - we cannot verify bead closure, so release to enforce postcondition.
   630	                tracing::warn!(
   631	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   632	                    error = %e,
   633	                    "show() failed, releasing bead to enforce postcondition"
   634	                );
   635	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   636	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   637	                    outcome: "success".to_string(),
   638	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   639	                    error: e.to_string(),
   640	                });
   641	                let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   642	                events.append(&mut release_events);
   643	                return Ok((BeadAction::Released, events));
   644	            }
   645	        }
   646	
   647	        // Flush SQLite state to JSONL so the closed/orphaned bead is captured in
   648	        // the git-committed backup. Non-fatal: a flush failure is logged but does
   649	        // not block the worker from picking up the next bead.
   650	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.flush(), "flush").await {
   651	            Ok(Some(())) => {
   652	                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, "flushed bead state to JSONL after success");
   653	            }
   654	            Ok(None) => {
   655	                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "flush timed out after success — JSONL may lag SQLite");
   656	            }
   657	            Err(e) => {
   658	                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, error = %e, "flush failed after success — JSONL may lag SQLite");
   659	            }
   660	        }
   661	
   662	        Ok((BeadAction::None, events))
   663	    }
   664	
   665	    /// Handle gate failure: reopen the bead if it was closed, then release it.
   666	    async fn handle_gate_failure(
   667	        &self,
   668	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   669	        bead: &Bead,
   670	        report: &crate::validation::GateReport,
   671	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   672	        // Find the first failing gate for telemetry.
   673	        let (failed_gate, reason) = report
   674	            .results
   675	            .iter()
   676	            .find(|(_, r)| !r.passed())
   677	            .map(|(name, r)| (name.clone(), r.failure_reason().unwrap_or("").to_string()))
   678	            .unwrap_or_else(|| ("unknown".to_string(), "unknown error".to_string()));
   679	
   680	        tracing::warn!(
   681	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   682	            gate = %failed_gate,
   683	            reason = %reason,
   684	            "validation gate failed — releasing bead"
   685	        );
   686	
   687	        // Emit verification failure telemetry.
   688	        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationFailed {
   689	            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   690	            command: failed_gate.clone(),
   691	            exit_code: None,
   692	            output: reason,
   693	        })?;
   694	
   695	        let mut events = Vec::new();
   696	
   697	        // If the agent already closed the bead, reopen it before releasing.
   698	        // Use timeout to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.
   699	        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), "show").await {
   700	            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {
   701	                tracing::info!(
   702	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   703	                    "reopening bead closed by agent (verification failed)"
   704	                );
   705	                match self.timeout_op(|| store.reopen(&bead.id), "reopen").await {
   706	                    Ok(_) => {}
   707	                    Err(e) => {
   708	                        tracing::warn!(
   709	                            bead_id = %bead.id,
   710	                            error = %e,
   710	                            error = %e,
   711	                            "failed to reopen bead — attempting release anyway"
   712	                        );
   713	                        events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   714	                            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   715	                            outcome: "gate_failure".to_string(),
   716	                            operation: "reopen".to_string(),
   717	                            error: e.to_string(),
   718	                        });
   719	                    }
   720	                }
   721	            }
   722	            Ok(None) => {
   723	                tracing::warn!(
   724	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   725	                    "show() timed out during gate failure handling, skipping reopen"
   726	                );
   727	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   728	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   729	                    outcome: "gate_failure".to_string(),
   730	                    operation: "show".to_string(),
   731	                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
   732	                });
   733	            }
   734	            Err(e) => {
   735	                tracing::warn!(
   736	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   737	                    error = %e,
   738	                    "show() failed during gate failure handling"
   739	                );
   740	            }
   741	            _ => {}
   742	        }
   743	
   744	        // Release the bead back to open with flush-before-release and sync recovery.
   745	        let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   746	        events.append(&mut release_events);
   747	
   748	        // If release succeeded, increment the failure count and apply the same
   749	        // quarantine ceiling `handle_failure` uses. Without this, a bead that
   750	        // fails a gate every cycle is released back to open forever: the
   751	        // ARMOR/bf-135k storm ran one bead 24 times in a single day, each
   752	        // attempt leaving another commit behind. A gate failure is no less
   753	        // repeatable than an agent failure and must respect the same ceiling.
   754	        let release_succeeded = events
   755	            .iter()
   756	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   757	        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;
   758	        if release_succeeded {
   759	            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   760	                Ok(new_count) => {
   761	                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;
   762	                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {
   763	                        match self
   764	                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)
   765	                            .await
   766	                        {
   767	                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {
   768	                                events.extend(quarantine_events);
   769	                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;
   770	                            }
   771	                            Err(e) => {
   772	                                tracing::warn!(
   773	                                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   774	                                    error = %e,
   775	                                    "failed to quarantine bead after exceeding gate-failure threshold"
   776	                                );
   777	                            }
   778	                        }
   779	                    }
   780	                }
   781	                Err(e) => {
   782	                    tracing::warn!(
   783	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   784	                        error = %e,
   785	                        "failed to increment failure count after gate failure"
   786	                    );
   787	                }
   788	            }
   789	        }
   790	
   791	        // Add a label indicating verification failure.
   792	        if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(
   793	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   794	            store.add_label(&bead.id, "verification-failed"),
   795	        )
   796	        .await
   797	        {
   798	            tracing::warn!(
   799	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   800	                error = %e,
   801	                "failed to add verification-failed label"
   802	            );
   803	        }
   804	
   805	        Ok((action, events))
   806	    }
   807	
   808	    /// Failure: release bead and increment failure count.
   809	    ///
   810	    /// Mitosis evaluation (for multi-task splitting) is handled externally by
   811	    /// the worker after outcome handling — see `MitosisEvaluator`.
   812	    ///
   813	    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not
   814	    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.
   815	    async fn handle_failure(
   816	        &self,
   817	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   818	        bead: &Bead,
   819	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   820	        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent failure — releasing bead");
   821	
   822	        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   823	
   824	        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and check the
   825	        // quarantine threshold. A bead that has exceeded
   826	        // `outcome.quarantine_after_failures` consecutive failures is
   827	        // quarantined (status=blocked) instead of being left released-to-open
   828	        // for the next cycle to re-claim and fail again indefinitely. This
   829	        // also closes the mitosis `NotSplittable` fallthrough (worker/mod.rs):
   830	        // that verdict no longer matters for beads at or past the ceiling,
   831	        // since this check already ran before mitosis evaluation this cycle.
   832	        let release_succeeded = events
   833	            .iter()
   834	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   835	        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;
   836	        if release_succeeded {
   837	            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   838	                Ok(new_count) => {
   839	                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;
   840	                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {
   841	                        match self
   842	                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)
   843	                            .await
   844	                        {
   845	                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {
   846	                                events.extend(quarantine_events);
   847	                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;
   848	                            }
   849	                            Err(e) => {
   850	                                tracing::warn!(
   851	                                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   852	                                    error = %e,
   853	                                    "failed to quarantine bead after exceeding failure threshold"
   854	                                );
   855	                            }
   856	                        }
   857	                    }
   858	                }
   859	                Err(e) => {
   860	                    tracing::warn!(
   861	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   862	                        error = %e,
   863	                        "failed to increment failure count after release"
   864	                    );
   865	                }
   866	            }
   867	        }
   868	
   869	        // Ensure we emit a reason event for telemetry.
   870	        if !events.iter().any(|e| {
   871	            matches!(
   872	                e,
   873	                EventKind::BeadReleased { .. } | EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { .. }
   874	            )
   875	        }) {
   876	            events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {
   877	                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   878	                reason: "failure".to_string(),
   879	            });
   880	        }
   881	
   882	        Ok((action, events))
   883	    }
   884	
   885	    /// Timeout: release bead and add `deferred` label.
   886	    ///
   887	    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not
   888	    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.
   889	    async fn handle_timeout(
   890	        &self,
   891	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   892	        bead: &Bead,
   893	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   894	        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, "agent timed out — releasing bead as deferred");
   895	
   896	        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   897	
   898	        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and add deferred label.
   899	        let release_succeeded = events
   900	            .iter()
   901	            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));
   902	        if release_succeeded {
   903	            // Increment failure count for auto-split tracking.
   904	            if let Err(e) = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {
   905	                tracing::warn!(
   906	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   907	                    error = %e,
   908	                    "failed to increment failure count after timeout"
   909	                );
   910	            }
   911	
   912	            if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(
   913	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   914	                store.add_label(&bead.id, "deferred"),
   915	            )
   916	            .await
   917	            {
   918	                tracing::warn!(
   919	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   920	                    error = %e,
   921	                    "add_label deferred timed out or failed after timeout release"
   922	                );
   923	                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
   924	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   925	                    outcome: "timeout".to_string(),
   926	                    operation: "add_label".to_string(),
   927	                    error: e.to_string(),
   928	                });
   929	            }
   930	        }
   931	
   932	        Ok((BeadAction::Deferred, events))
   933	    }
   934	
   935	    /// Crash: release bead and create alert bead with diagnostic info.
   936	    async fn handle_crash(
   937	        &self,
   938	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   939	        bead: &Bead,
   940	        signal_code: i32,
   941	    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {
   942	        tracing::error!(
   943	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   944	            signal_code,
   945	            agent = %self.config.agent.default,
   946	            "agent crashed — releasing bead and creating alert"
   947	        );
   948	
   949	        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;
   950	
   951	        // Create alert bead with diagnostic info (best-effort).
   952	        let signal_num = if signal_code > 128 {
   953	            signal_code - 128
   954	        } else {
   955	            signal_code
   956	        };
   957	        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
   958	        let alert_title = format!("ALERT: Agent crash on bead {}", bead.id);
   959	        let alert_body = format!(
   960	            "## Agent Crash Report\n\
   961	             \n\
   962	             - **Bead ID**: {}\n\
   963	             - **Agent**: {}\n\
   964	             - **Exit code**: {} (signal {})\n\
   965	             - **Workspace**: {}\n\
   966	             - **Timestamp**: {}\n\
   967	             \n\
   968	             The agent process was killed. This bead has been released for retry.",
   969	            bead.id,
   970	            self.config.agent.default,
   971	            signal_code,
   972	            signal_num,
   973	            bead.workspace.display(),
   974	            timestamp,
   975	        );
   976	
   977	        // Hook 4: propagate stitch labels from the crashed bead to the alert.
   978	        let signal_label = format!("signal-{}", signal_num);
   979	        let mut alert_labels: Vec<String> = vec!["alert".into(), "crash".into(), signal_label];
   980	        alert_labels.extend(crate::types::extract_stitch_labels(&bead.labels));
   981	        let alert_label_refs: Vec<&str> = alert_labels.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
   982	        match tokio::time::timeout(
   983	            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
   984	            store.create_bead(&alert_title, &alert_body, &alert_label_refs),
   985	        )
   986	        .await
   987	        {
   988	            Ok(Ok(alert_id)) => {
   989	                tracing::info!(
   990	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   991	                    %alert_id,
   992	                    "crash alert bead created"
   993	                );
   994	            }
   995	            Ok(Err(e)) => {
   996	                tracing::warn!(
   997	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   998	                    error = %e,
   999	                    "failed to create crash alert bead"
  1000	                );
  1001	            }
  1002	            Err(_) => {
  1003	                tracing::warn!(
  1004	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
  1005	                    "create_bead timed out after 30s during crash handling"
  1006	                );
  1007	            }
  1008	        }
  1009	
  1010	        Ok((BeadAction::Alerted, events))
  1011	    }
  1012	
  1013	    /// AgentNotFound: release bead, emit error. No retry — this is a config issue.
  1014	    async fn handle_agent_not_found(

//! Abstract bead store interface and CLI implementations.
//!
//! NEEDLE interacts with beads exclusively through the `BeadStore` trait. The
//! default implementation shells out to `bf` (bead-forge) with `--json` output.
//! JSON parsing failures are explicit errors — never silently treated as empty
//! results (v1 bug).
//!
//! The trait is `Send + Sync` because it is called from async worker tasks.
//!
//! `CliBeadStore` binds one backend descriptor to one executable, preventing
//! command grammar and binary identity from being mixed accidentally.
//!
//! IMPORTANT: authors of the `bead-rs`/beads_rust descriptor must probe the
//! actual beads_rust binary (including its help and output), not infer its
//! dialect from this module, `CliBeadStore`, or the bead-forge descriptor.
//!
//! Depends on: `types`.

mod backend;
mod cli_store;
mod strategies;

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::path::Path;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;

use crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, ClaimResult};
use tracing::{debug, warn};

// Re-export the implementations so consumers don't need to change their imports
pub use backend::{
    builtin_bead_backends, load_bead_backends, BeadBackend, BeadBackendCapabilities,
    BeadBackendErrorMarkers, BeadBackendQuirk, BeadOperationSpec, ParseShape,
};
pub use cli_store::CliBeadStore;

/// Open the bead store explicitly bound by the target workspace's resolved
/// configuration. This is the production entry point: executable discovery
/// alone is never treated as evidence of store ownership.
pub fn open_configured(
    config: &crate::config::BeadCliConfig,
    workspace: PathBuf,
    model: Option<String>,
    harness: Option<String>,
    harness_version: Option<String>,
) -> Result<Arc<dyn BeadStore>> {
    if matches!(config.backend, crate::config::BeadBackend::Auto) {
        bail!(
            "workspace {} has no authoritative bead backend binding; set bead_cli.backend in {}",
            workspace.display(),
            workspace.join(".needle.yaml").display()
        );
    }

    let (backend, binary) = crate::config::resolve_bead_cli(config).with_context(|| {
        format!(
            "failed to resolve bead_cli.backend for workspace {}",
            workspace.display()
        )
    })?;
    verify_backend_identity(&backend, &binary, &workspace)?;
    if backend == crate::config::Backend::Bead {
        verify_bead_rs_capabilities(&binary, &workspace)?;
    }

    match backend {
        crate::config::Backend::Bf => {
            let descriptor = builtin_bead_backends()
                .into_iter()
                .find(|candidate| candidate.name == "bead-forge")
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("built-in bead-forge descriptor is missing"))?;
            Ok(Arc::new(CliBeadStore::new(
                descriptor,
                binary,
                workspace,
                model,
                harness,
                harness_version,
            )?))
        }
        crate::config::Backend::Bead => {
            let descriptor = builtin_bead_backends()
                .into_iter()
                .find(|candidate| candidate.name == "bead-rs")
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("built-in bead-rs descriptor is missing"))?;
            Ok(Arc::new(CliBeadStore::new(
                descriptor,
                binary,
                workspace,
                model,
                harness,
                harness_version,
            )?))
        }
    }
}

fn verify_backend_identity(
    backend: &crate::config::Backend,
    binary: &Path,
    workspace: &Path,
) -> Result<()> {
    use regex::Regex;
    use std::io::Read;
    use std::process::Stdio;

    // Get the backend descriptor for this backend type
    let descriptor_name = match backend {
        crate::config::Backend::Bf => "bead-forge",
        crate::config::Backend::Bead => "bead-rs",
    };

    let descriptor = builtin_bead_backends()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|d| d.name == descriptor_name)
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            anyhow::anyhow!(
                "built-in backend descriptor '{}' not found",
                descriptor_name
            )
        })?;

    let mut child = spawn_with_etxtbsy_retry_sync_child(
        || {
            std::process::Command::new(binary)
                .args(&descriptor.version_command)
                .stdout(Stdio::piped())
                .stderr(Stdio::piped())
                .spawn()
        },
        5,  // max_attempts
        20, // backoff_ms
    )
    .with_context(|| {
        format!(
            "failed to inspect bead CLI identity at {}",
            binary.display()
        )
    })?;
    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(5);
    let status = loop {
        if let Some(status) = child.try_wait().with_context(|| {
            format!(
                "failed waiting for bead CLI identity at {}",
                binary.display()
            )
        })? {
            break status;
        }
        if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            let _ = child.kill();
            let _ = child.wait();
            bail!(
                "timed out verifying bead backend identity for workspace {} at {}",
                workspace.display(),
                binary.display()
            );
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
    };
    let mut stdout = Vec::new();
    let mut stderr = Vec::new();
    if let Some(mut stream) = child.stdout.take() {
        stream.read_to_end(&mut stdout)?;
    }
    if let Some(mut stream) = child.stderr.take() {
        stream.read_to_end(&mut stderr)?;
    }
    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&stdout);
    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&stderr);
    let identity = format!("{stdout}{stderr}");

    if !status.success() {
        bail!(
            "bead backend identity check failed for workspace {}: {} --version exited with code {} (output: {:?})",
            workspace.display(),
            binary.display(),
            status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
            identity.trim()
        );
    }

    // Parse the version output using the descriptor's identity_pattern
    let identity_pattern = Regex::new(&descriptor.identity_pattern).with_context(|| {
        format!(
            "invalid identity_pattern regex for backend '{}': {:?}",
            descriptor.name, descriptor.identity_pattern
        )
    })?;

    let trimmed_output = identity.trim_start();
    if !identity_pattern.is_match(trimmed_output) {
        bail!(
            "bead backend identity mismatch for workspace {}: binary at {} reported version {:?}, which does not match expected pattern {:?} for backend '{}'",
            workspace.display(),
            binary.display(),
            trimmed_output,
            descriptor.identity_pattern,
            descriptor.name
        );
    }

    // Extract the backend name from the version output
    // The pattern captures the name at the start (e.g., "bf " or "bead ")
    let captured_name = trimmed_output
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            anyhow::anyhow!(
                "bead backend identity extraction failed for workspace {}: binary at {} reported empty version output",
                workspace.display(),
                binary.display()
            )
        })?;

    // Map the captured name to the expected backend name
    // Both "bf" and "bead" should map to their respective backend names
    let expected_names = match descriptor.name.as_str() {
        "bead-forge" => vec!["bf", "bead-forge"],
        "bead-rs" => vec!["bead", "bead-rs"],
        _ => vec![descriptor.name.as_str()],
    };

    if !expected_names.contains(&captured_name) {
        bail!(
            "bead backend identity mismatch for workspace {}: binary at {} reported name {:?}, but expected one of {:?} for backend '{}'",
            workspace.display(),
            binary.display(),
            captured_name,
            expected_names,
            descriptor.name
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn verify_bead_rs_capabilities(binary: &Path, workspace: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    let output = spawn_with_etxtbsy_retry_sync(
        || {

            binary.display(),

            != Some(true)

            workspace.display()
        );
    }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum IdleAction {
    /// Poll again after `idle_timeout` seconds.
    #[default]
    Wait,
    /// Exit cleanly.
    Exit,
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BeadAction
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Action taken on a bead by the outcome handler.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BeadAction {
    /// Bead was released back to open status.
    Released,
    /// Bead was deferred (e.g., timeout with deferred label).
    Deferred,
    /// An alert bead was created.
    Alerted,
    /// Bead was quarantined (status=blocked, labeled `cycling`) after
    /// exceeding the consecutive-failure threshold.
    Quarantined,
    /// No action taken (e.g., success with bead already closed).
    None,
}

impl fmt::Display for BeadAction {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            BeadAction::Released => write!(f, "released"),
            BeadAction::Deferred => write!(f, "deferred"),
            BeadAction::Alerted => write!(f, "alerted"),
            BeadAction::Quarantined => write!(f, "quarantined"),
            BeadAction::None => write!(f, "none"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct HandlerResult {
    /// The classified outcome.
    pub outcome: Outcome,
    /// Action taken on the bead.
    pub bead_action: BeadAction,
    /// Telemetry events emitted during handling.
    pub telemetry_events: Vec<crate::telemetry::EventKind>,
}

 succeeded in 0ms:
ID: needle-3386daef
Title: Enforce the dispatch postcondition: a worker returns its bead closed/open/errored, NEVER in_progress
Status: Open
Priority: P0
Revision: 27
Created: 2026-08-17T05:43:10.948214447Z
Updated: 2026-08-19T16:53:53.360037416Z
Description: SYSTEMIC. This supersedes the patch-shaped framing of needle-55ec0193, which is now
blocked behind this bead and reduced to the narrow orphan-branch change.

THE INVARIANT: a dispatch cycle must terminate with the bead in a terminal state --
closed, or returned to the frontier as open/unassigned, or errored+failure-counted.
in_progress is a state a worker HOLDS, never a state it LEAVES BEHIND. Today nothing
enforces this, so any code path that forgets to return the bead leaks a claim
permanently, and new paths can reintroduce the leak at any time.

ROOT DEFECT -- success is defined by the wrong signal. classify(0, false) ==
Outcome::Success. Exit code 0 means "the agent process terminated normally". NEEDLE
reads it as "the work is correct". Everything downstream inherits that mistake. The
orphan branch at outcome/mod.rs:487-496 exists ONLY to reconcile the resulting
contradiction -- "we already declared success but the bead is still open" -- and it
resolves it by emitting BeadOrphaned and doing nothing. Patching that branch fixes
todays leak; enforcing the postcondition fixes the class, including paths nobody has
written yet.

FIX
 1. Success must MEAN verification passed, not be an input to it. An agent exiting 0
    whose verification fails is a Failure outcome -- released and failure-counted,
    quarantining at threshold -- not a success carrying a warning. Make the
    classification depend on verification rather than on exit code alone.
 2. Make the postcondition structurally enforced, not conventional. The dispatch cycle
    should not be able to return without transitioning the bead; e.g. have the handler
    return a BeadAction the caller must apply, so "no transition" is unrepresentable
    rather than merely discouraged.
 3. A worker holds at most ONE claim. Multi-claim is prima facie evidence of a leak,
    so it should be an assertable invariant, not an emergent property.

LIVE EVIDENCE -- this bead class demonstrated itself on 2026-08-17. needle-55ec0193,
the bead describing the leak, was worked THREE times and leaked every time:
    02:52 claim -> 02:58 complete outcome=success (6min)   worker needle-otlp-test
    04:49 claim -> 04:59 timeout                (10min)    worker seam-2
    05:04 claim -> 05:35 complete outcome=success (32min)  worker luna-needle
    05:35 re-claimed by luna-needle in the SAME SECOND as its own success
~48 minutes of agent time across three workers, zero commits referencing the bead, and
it never left in_progress. A patch to one branch would not have prevented this; the
postcondition would.

WHY GATES ARE NOT THE FIX: adding validation gates was considered and rejected as the
primary remedy. The system already has many OPTIONAL checks and zero mandatory ones --
gates unconfigured in 66 of 71 workspaces, CI advisory and red for 6+ runs unnoticed,
53 of 54 integration test files never run, pre-commit bypassed via --no-verify for 23
commits. Adding one more optional check does not fix a system whose defect is that
checks are optional. Gates are worth wiring only as the carrier for a single declared
definition of done -- see needle-DOD.

RELATED: needle-f6afd68c (mend claim-age reclamation) SHIPPED in ecc207d and is the
safety net for this defect -- it now releases stale claims regardless of holder
liveness. That bounds the damage; it does not stop the leak. This bead stops the leak.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- No dispatch path can return leaving the bead in_progress; enforced structurally, not
  by convention.
- Verification result, not exit code alone, determines Success vs Failure.
- A worker never holds more than one claim; asserted in a regression test.
- The existing test handle_success_bead_still_open_emits_orphaned is inverted -- it
  currently asserts the leak and would otherwise lock the bug in.
- A regression test reproduces the 2026-08-17 loop: agent exits 0 without closing, and
  the bead must NOT be re-dispatchable while still held.

   424	        let raw = self.run_operation("show", &show_values).await?;
   425	        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(raw.trim())?;
   426	        let value = value
   427	            .as_array()
   428	            .and_then(|items| items.first())
   429	            .unwrap_or(&value);
   430	        if value.get("status").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) != Some("open") {
   431	            return Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {
   432	                reason: "bead changed state before claim".to_string(),
   433	            });
   434	        }
   435	        if let Some(claimed_by) = value.get("assignee").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
   436	            if !claimed_by.is_empty() {
   437	                return Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost {
   438	                    claimed_by: claimed_by.to_string(),
   439	                });
   440	            }
   441	        }
   442	        let revision = value
   443	            .get("revision")
   444	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
   445	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("bead-rs show response omitted revision"))?;
   446	        let args = vec![
   447	            "update".to_string(),
   448	            id.to_string(),
   449	            "--status".to_string(),
   450	            "in_progress".to_string(),
   451	            "--assignee".to_string(),
   452	            actor.to_string(),
   453	            "--if-revision".to_string(),
   454	            revision.to_string(),
   455	        ];
   456	        match self.run_argv("claim", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS).await {
   457	            Ok(_) => Ok(ClaimResult::Claimed(self.show(id).await?)),
   458	            Err(error) if error.to_string().contains("code 4") => {
   459	                let latest = self.show(id).await?;
   460	                match latest.assignee {
   461	                    Some(claimed_by) => Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by }),
   462	                    None => Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {
   463	                        reason: "bead changed during claim".to_string(),
   464	                    }),
   465	                }
   466	            }
   467	            Err(error) => Err(error),
   468	        }
   469	    }

The existing code already has a descriptive `BeadAction`, but it still includes `None`, and the worker’s handling state returns `Result<()>`. That leaves exactly the representable “no transition” hole the bead describes. I’m tightening this boundary by removing `None`, adding explicit closed/error/interrupted terminal actions, making the handling state return a must-use action, and making the state-machine caller consume it through one exhaustive application point.

    #[test]
    fn classify_not_interrupted_uses_exit_code_and_verification() {
        // Exit code 0 with verification passes → Success
        assert_eq!(classify(0, false, true), Outcome::Success);
        // Exit code 0 with verification fails → Failure
        assert_eq!(classify(0, false, false), Outcome::Failure);
        // Non-zero exit codes always fail regardless of verification
        assert_eq!(classify(1, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(1, false, false), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(124, false, true), Outcome::Timeout);
        assert_eq!(classify(127, false, true), Outcome::AgentNotFound);
        assert_eq!(classify(129, false, true), Outcome::Crash(129));
    }

    #[test]
    fn classify_no_wildcard_arms() {
        // Verify key exit codes map correctly per spec.
        // Exit code 0 ONLY succeeds when verification passes
        assert_eq!(classify(0, false, true), Outcome::Success);
        assert_eq!(classify(0, false, false), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(1, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(2, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(99, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(100, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(124, false, true), Outcome::Timeout);
        assert_eq!(classify(125, false, true), Outcome::Failure);
        assert_eq!(classify(128, false, true), Outcome::Failure); // not >128 per spec
        assert_eq!(classify(129, false, true), Outcome::Crash(129));
        assert_eq!(classify(137, false, true), Outcome::Crash(137));
        assert_eq!(classify(-9, false, true), Outcome::Crash(-9));

            r#"{{"event_type":"effort.recorded","timestamp":"{}T12:00:00Z","data":{{"estimated_cost_usd":8.0}}}}"#,
            today
        );
        std::fs::write(log_dir.join("worker.jsonl"), &log_content).unwrap();

        let store: Arc<dyn BeadStore> = Arc::new(MockStore::empty());
        let mut config = valid_test_config();
        config.self_modification.hot_reload = false;
        config.workspace.home = dir.path().to_path_buf();
        config.telemetry.file_sink.log_dir = Some(log_dir);
        config.budget.warn_usd = 5.0; // Cost (8) exceeds warn but not stop.
        config.budget.stop_usd = 20.0;
        // Pin workspace_root to prevent Explore strand from scanning real home
        config.strands.explore.workspace_root = dir.path().to_path_buf();
        config.strands.explore.workspaces = Vec::new();

        let mut worker = Worker::new(config, "test-budget-warn".to_string(), store);
        worker.boot().unwrap();

        worker.check_budget().unwrap();
        // State should still be Selecting — warn doesn't stop the worker.
        assert_eq!(*worker.state(), WorkerState::Selecting);
    }

  4311	impl Drop for Worker {
  4312	    fn drop(&mut self) {
  4313	        // Clear the global shutdown flag when the worker is dropped.
  4314	        // This prevents dangling pointers if the worker is dropped without
  4315	        // calling stop() (e.g., due to panic or early return).
  4316	        #[cfg(unix)]
  4317	        {
  4318	            clear_global_shutdown_flag();
  4319	        }
  4320	
  4321	        // Join the watchdog thread if it was started.
  4322	        // Set the trigger flag to signal the thread to exit.
  4323	        self.watchdog_triggered.store(true, Ordering::Release);
  4324	        if let Some(handle) = self.watchdog_handle.take() {
  4325	            // Don't block indefinitely joining the thread during drop.
  4326	            // If it doesn't exit within 1 second, we'll still continue.
  4327	            let _ = handle.join();
  4328	        }
  4329	    }
  4330	}

  4334	/// br's JSON output sets `source_repo` to `"."` (cwd-relative) for local

  4336	/// strand's absolute workspace path is preserved through the claim cycle.
  4337	fn is_workspace_unset(path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
  4338	    let s = path.as_os_str();
  4339	    s.is_empty() || s == "."
  4340	}

  4502	    fn make_worker(store: Arc<dyn BeadStore>) -> Worker {
  4503	        let mut config = valid_test_config();
  4504	        // Disable hot-reload in tests — it would re-exec into a different binary.
  4505	        config.self_modification.hot_reload = false;
  4506	        // Disable Explore: it defaults to scanning the real $HOME for any
  4507	        // `.beads/` directory and operating on whatever it finds via the real
  4508	        // `bf`/`br` CLI. This shared helper is used by unit tests that never
  4509	        // intend to exercise real filesystem discovery (that's what
  4510	        // strand::explore::tests own, with its own tempdir isolation) — a
  4511	        // multi-cycle test using this helper (e.g. via `.run()`) previously
  4512	        // reached a real Explore scan once its MockStore emptied out,
  4513	        // claiming/mutating real beads across unrelated repos on this
  4514	        // server. See bf-2unnq's contamination addendum.
  4515	        config.strands.explore.enabled = false;
  4516	        // Pin Explore scan root to a tempdir so the Explore strand cannot
  4517	        // scan the real home directory if it ever runs. Even though Explore
  4518	        // is disabled above, defense-in-depth ensures tests are isolated.
  4519	        let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
  4520	        config.strands.explore.workspace_root = temp_dir.path().to_path_buf();
  4521	        config.strands.explore.workspaces = Vec::new();
  4522	        Worker::new(config, "test-worker".to_string(), store)
  4523	    }

  4525	    /// Return a configuration whose selected adapter is one of NEEDLE's
  4526	    /// built-ins. `Config::default()` intentionally names the legacy
  4527	    /// operator-provided `claude` adapter, which is absent in isolated CI.
  4528	    fn valid_test_config() -> Config {
  4529	        let mut config = Config::default();
  4530	        config.agent.default = "claude-sonnet".to_string();
  4531	        // Isolate operator state. `workspace.home` defaults to the real
  4532	        // `~/.needle`, whose `state/workers.json` is the live fleet's worker
  4533	        // registry — booting a test worker registered into it and raced both
  4534	        // the fleet and the other tests sharing this worker id. `adapters_dir`
  4535	        // is pinned alongside it so adapter resolution sees only built-ins and
  4536	        // never depends on what the operator happens to have installed.
  4537	        let home = crate::util::test_env::isolated_home();
  4538	        config.agent.adapters_dir = home.join("adapters");
  4539	        config.workspace.home = home;
  4540	        // Drop the default routing rules. They rewrite any sonnet/opus/fable/

4377:    struct MockStore {
                            bead_id = %bead.id,
                            label,
                            "remove_label timed out after 30s"
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if removed_count > 0 {
            tracing::debug!(
                bead_id = %bead.id,
                removed_count,
                "failure count reset"
            );
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Quarantine a bead by setting status=blocked and adding the 'cycling' label.
    ///
    /// This is called when a bead exceeds the configured failure threshold.
    /// Emits a BeadQuarantined telemetry event.
    ///
    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in
    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.
    async fn quarantine_bead(
        &self,
        store: &dyn BeadStore,
        bead: &Bead,
        failure_count: u32,
        threshold: u32,
    ) -> Result<Vec<EventKind>> {
        let mut events = Vec::new();

        tracing::warn!(
            bead_id = %bead.id,
            failure_count,
            threshold,
            "quarantining bead after exceeding failure threshold"
        );

        // Set status=blocked with timeout. This is what actually stops Pluck
        // from re-selecting the bead — the 'cycling' label below is a
        // human-facing marker, not the enforcement mechanism.
        match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.block(&bead.id)).await
        {
            Ok(Ok(())) => {
                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, "set status=blocked");
            }
            Ok(Err(e)) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    error = %e,
                    "failed to set status=blocked during quarantine"
                );
                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    outcome: "quarantine".to_string(),
                    operation: "block".to_string(),
                    error: e.to_string(),
                });
            }
            Err(_) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    "block timed out after 30s during quarantine"
                );
                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    outcome: "quarantine".to_string(),
                    operation: "block".to_string(),
                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
                });
            }
        }

        // Add the 'cycling' label with timeout.
        match tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
            store.add_label(&bead.id, "cycling"),
        )
        .await
        {
            Ok(Ok(())) => {
                tracing::debug!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    "added 'cycling' label"
                );
            }
            Ok(Err(e)) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    error = %e,
                    "failed to add 'cycling' label"
                );
                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    outcome: "quarantine".to_string(),
                    operation: "add_label".to_string(),
                    error: e.to_string(),
                });
            }
            Err(_) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    "add_label timed out after 30s"
                );
                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    outcome: "quarantine".to_string(),
                    operation: "add_label".to_string(),
                    error: "timeout after 30s".to_string(),
                });
            }
        }

        // Emit the BeadQuarantined event.
        events.push(EventKind::BeadQuarantined {
            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
            failure_count,
            threshold,
        });

        Ok(events)
    }
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Outcome Display
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

impl fmt::Display for Outcome {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Outcome::Success => write!(f, "Success"),
            Outcome::Failure => write!(f, "Failure"),
            Outcome::Timeout => write!(f, "Timeout"),
            Outcome::AgentNotFound => write!(f, "AgentNotFound"),
            Outcome::Interrupted => write!(f, "Interrupted"),
            Outcome::Crash(code) => write!(f, "Crash({})", code),
        }
    }
}

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
     }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.

+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition

+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
     }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+        let bead = self

+

+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,

+            Err(_) => {

+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );

+            }
+        };

+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
