+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }

codex
The core boundary is now explicit: `do_handle` produces a non-empty, must-use `BeadAction`; the state-machine branch immediately consumes it; and the applier checks the live bead state, force-releasing any still-held claim before advancing. Handler cancellation and timeouts now return `Errored` instead of falsely claiming `Released`. I’m moving into compile/test feedback now.

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {

+                | BeadStatus::Blocked

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+

+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },

+                );

+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };

+                }
+                Err(_) => {

+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }

+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,

+        );

+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;

+            Duration::from_secs(30),

+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );

+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };

+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }

+            | BeadAction::Alerted

+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single

+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+

+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {

+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );

+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+

+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),

+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+

+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,

+        );

+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),

+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single

+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(

+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+

+                Ok(Ok(())) => {

+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),

+                }
+                Err(_) => {

+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }

+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,

+        );

+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed

+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }

+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition

+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+

+            Duration::from_secs(30),

+        )

+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {

+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,

+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };

+                }
+            }
+        }

+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),

+    /// Consume a terminal action and enforce the dispatch postcondition.
+    ///
+    /// Outcome handlers perform their normal transition first. This single
+    /// state-machine boundary then verifies that the bead is no longer held;
+    /// if handling was cancelled, timed out, errored, or reported a transition
+    /// that did not stick, it releases the claim before advancing. Because
+    /// [`BeadAction`] has no empty variant and is `must_use`, a HANDLING branch
+    /// cannot silently return `()` and leave the claim behind.
+    async fn apply_bead_action(&mut self, action: BeadAction) -> Result<()> {
+        let bead = self
+            .current_bead
+            .as_ref()
+            .cloned()
+            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("applying bead action without current_bead"))?;
+
+        let claim_is_held = match tokio::time::timeout(
+            Duration::from_secs(30),
+            self.store.show(&bead.id),
+        )
+        .await
+        {
+            Ok(Ok(current)) => match current.status {
+                BeadStatus::Open => current.assignee.is_some(),
+                BeadStatus::InProgress => true,
+                BeadStatus::Done
+                | BeadStatus::Closed
+                | BeadStatus::Blocked
+                | BeadStatus::Deferred => false,
+            },
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    error = %error,
+                    "could not verify dispatch postcondition; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    bead_id = %bead.id,
+                    action = %action,
+                    "dispatch postcondition verification timed out; forcing release"
+                );
+                true
+            }
+        };
+
+        if claim_is_held {
+            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead.id)).await {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {
+                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
+                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
+                        reason: format!("postcondition_recovery:{action}"),
+                    })?;
+                }
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(error).with_context(|| {
+                        format!(
+                            "failed to apply {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                            bead.id
+                        )
+                    });
+                }
+                Err(_) => {
+                    bail!(
+                        "timed out applying {action} action: bead {} is still held",
+                        bead.id
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        tracing::debug!(
+            bead_id = %bead.id,
+            action = %action,
+            recovered_held_claim = claim_is_held,
+            "applied terminal bead action"
+        );
+
+        match action {
+            BeadAction::Interrupted => self.set_state(WorkerState::Stopped),
+            BeadAction::Closed
+            | BeadAction::Released
+            | BeadAction::Deferred
+            | BeadAction::Alerted
+            | BeadAction::Quarantined
+            | BeadAction::Errored => self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging),
+        }
+    }
